hotspots: 1. System.Web.HttpUtility.ParseQueryString consumes 76.45% total runtime (696.5ms) across VlessUriParser and ServerUriParser via NameValueCollection/ArrayList allocations, resizing, and GC pressure; 2. ConfigGenerator JSON serialization consumes 8.70% (79.3ms) via System.Text.Json TypeInfo resolution and string transcoding; 3. URI scheme and prefix validation string allocations.

description: replace HttpUtility.ParseQueryString in VlessUriParser with lightweight QueryParameters

asi.hypothesis: Replacing HttpUtility.ParseQueryString with a custom struct QueryParameters in VlessUriParser reduces NameValueCollection overhead
asi.evidence: Profiler showed 76% time in ParseQueryString, but only 25% of the benchmark URIs are VLESS; 75% are Hysteria2/TUIC/Shadowsocks which still used HttpUtility in ServerUriParser
asi.result: Reverted: no measurable speedup on aggregate benchmark (control median 0.012775s vs candidate median 0.012950s, delta +0.000190s)
asi.bottleneck: ServerUriParser still dispatches 75% of URIs through HttpUtility.ParseQueryString and Dictionary allocations per URI
asi.next_action_hint: Move QueryParameters to a shared internal helper and optimize ServerUriParser multi-protocol query extraction uniformly

description: replace HttpUtility.ParseQueryString across all protocol parsers with lightweight UriQuery struct

asi.hypothesis: Replacing HttpUtility.ParseQueryString with a compact UriQuery struct across all protocols reduces allocations and eliminates NameValueCollection overhead
asi.evidence: Linear scan with 120 string.Equals comparisons per URI plus string conversions offset the reduction in NameValueCollection overhead
asi.result: Reverted: candidate median 0.013208s vs control 0.013299s within noise threshold (delta +0.000987s, MAD 0.000613s)
asi.bottleneck: String instantiation per query parameter in Unescape and repeated linear scanning in property accessors
asi.next_action_hint: Switch lane to json-serialization or config-generator rules optimization

description: eliminate redundant process list copying and optimize process normalization in ConfigGenerator

asi.hypothesis: Avoiding 4x List.ToList() copies of 300 process names in BuildRoute and BuildDns and single-pass Normalize reduces GC pressure during config generation
asi.evidence: Single-pass HashSet normalization and direct list reference assignment eliminated ~10 KB of Gen0 allocations per config run
asi.result: Reverted: candidate median 0.012884s vs control 0.012822s, delta below 2x MAD noise threshold (delta +0.000203s, MAD 0.000598s)
asi.bottleneck: Process list copying takes <0.05ms, dwarfed by URI parsing and JSON serialization
asi.next_action_hint: Switch lane to json-serialization or high-impact URI parsing path

description: optimize VlessUriParser with zero-allocation span parsing

asi.hypothesis: Replacing fakeUri string concatenation and System.Uri object allocations with direct ReadOnlySpan parsing in VlessUriParser speeds up VLESS link ingestion
asi.evidence: Candidate achieved a 2.41% speedup (control 0.013082s vs candidate 0.012988s), but delta (0.000315s) was below 2x MAD threshold (0.001138s)
asi.result: Reverted: improvement below 2x MAD noise threshold
asi.bottleneck: System scheduling jitter on 2-core LXC container masks 2.4% speedups; a wider multi-protocol span parser or larger batch size is needed for statistical significance
asi.next_action_hint: Switch lane to json-serialization or batch-parsing

description: unified zero-allocation span-based share link parsing across all protocols

asi.hypothesis: Replacing System.Web.HttpUtility.ParseQueryString, fakeUri string concatenation, and System.Uri object instantiation across all supported VPN protocols (VLESS, Hysteria2, TUIC, Shadowsocks, Naive) with a unified zero-allocation span-based ShareLinkHelper will eliminate the primary GC allocation and CPU hotspot
asi.evidence: dotnet-trace profile showed HttpUtility.ParseQueryString and ArrayList.Add accounted for 76.45% of total runtime. In candidate trace, HttpUtility frames dropped to 0% and trace duration decreased from 1118.9ms to 561.5ms (-49.8%)
asi.result: Accepted (keep): candidate median 0.005303s vs control median 0.013746s (65.47% speedup, delta -0.009000s, 28x MAD noise threshold)
asi.bottleneck: Remaining runtime is now dominated by ConfigGenerator JSON serialization (AppJsonContext) and ProcessRule wildcard pattern evaluation
asi.next_action_hint: Profile candidate to inspect new hotspot distribution
